name: Bounty Hunter
author: DrLegitamate
description: Extra bolts for every enemy kill, with kill streaks and a wrench bonus, and a bounty contract on every map: one wanted enemy, painted in its own colour, to be finished off with a weapon picked from your arsenal for a big payout.

settings.name: Enable Bounty Hunter
settings.description: Off: the mod does nothing at all.

settings.name: Base Enemy Bounty
settings.description: Extra bolts for a Standard enemy kill (0: no kill bounty, contracts only).

settings.name: Streak Duration (seconds)
settings.description: How long a kill streak waits for the next kill.

settings.name: Maximum Streak Multiplier
settings.description: Each kill in a streak raises the multiplier by one, up to this.

settings.name: Wrench Bounty Multiplier
settings.description: Times the bounty for a kill whose final blow was the OmniWrench; stacks with the streak.

settings.name: Enemy Bounty Tiers
settings.description: Scale the bounty by the enemy's own bolt drop: Basic half, Advanced double, Elite four times.

settings.name: Show Bounty Notifications
settings.description: A short line above the HUD for each bounty paid.

settings.name: Enable Map Contracts
settings.description: One wanted enemy and one required weapon on every map.

settings.name: Contract Reward Multiplier
settings.description: A contract kill pays this many times the target's normal bounty (its tier, before streak and wrench).

settings.name: Automatically Equip Required Weapon
settings.description: Put the required weapon in Ratchet's hand once, as the contract starts.

settings.name: Include OmniWrench in Required Weapon Pool
settings.description: Let a contract require a wrench kill.

settings.name: Require Available Ammunition
settings.description: Only require a weapon with ammunition left (or endless ammunition).

settings.name: Highlight Wanted Enemy
settings.description: Paint the wanted enemy in its contract colour, or mark it until the paint can go on.

settings.name: Target Hue Mode
settings.description: A new colour on every map, or always the hue below.

settings.name: Fixed Target Hue
settings.description: Degrees on the colour wheel: 0 red, 120 green, 210 azure, 300 magenta.

settings.name: Target Glow Level
settings.description: How strongly the painted enemy's rim glows (OpenRAC 1.34 or newer).

settings.name: Show Target Notifications
settings.description: The contract's announcements and its corner indicator.
